mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) relative to its long-term average compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS is below 2.0%, the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.5% signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 5.5%, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in the labor market (PAYEMS growth) and elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL) signal an impending monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 3.5% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5%, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals a slowdown in the housing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion, when HOUST declines > 1.0% in 3 months, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a slowdown in the real economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO declines > 0.5% in 3 months, the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Strong retail sales (RSAFS) growth signals robust consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When RSAFS growth > 0.8% in 3 months, the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals aggressive policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In monetary tightening cycle, when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5% in 3 months, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) below its 4-quarter moving average signals economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When GDPC1 < 4-quarter moving average, the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances.
